akhfash:26-26.t: He said ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ﴾ with yāʾ, meaning "has it not made clear?". Some read ﴿أَوَ لَمْ نَهْدِ﴾, i.e. "have We not made clear to them?"

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿الم﴾ Letters with no grammatical position. ﴿تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتابِ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed to الكتاب. ﴿لا﴾ The lā of generic negation. ﴿رَيْبَ﴾ Its ism, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of lā; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّ﴾ The khabar of تنزيل. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَإِذا ضَلَلْنا﴾ The hamza is for interrogation, iḏā is a non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾ The hamza is an interrogative particle, and inna and its ism. ﴿لَفِي﴾ The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿في خَلْقٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿جَدِيدٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of خلق; the clause confirms what precedes it. ﴿بَلْ﴾ A particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ﴾ fāʿil, annexed to الموت; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of ملك. ﴿وُكِّلَ﴾ A passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ A passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وَلَوْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A non-jussive conditional. ﴿تَرى﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِذِ﴾ An adverb of time. ﴿الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ناكِسُوا رُؤُسِهِمْ﴾ khabar (predicate), annexed to رؤوسهم; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ An adverb of place. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The apodosis of law is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen a terrible thing (la-raʾayta amran faẓīʿan)".
﴿رَبَّنا﴾ The one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf). ﴿أَبْصَرْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause, like the vocative clause, is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf). ﴿وَسَمِعْنا﴾ Conjoined to أبصرنا. ﴿فَارْجِعْنا﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and a verb of supplication and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿نَعْمَلْ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿صالِحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿مُوقِنُونَ﴾ Its khabar; the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A non-jussive conditional. ﴿شِئْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَآتَيْنا﴾ The lām falls in the apodosis, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿كُلَّ نَفْسٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to نفس. ﴿هُداها﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ Lightened from the heavy [lākinna] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla). ﴿حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنِّي﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ﴾ The lām falls in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَالنَّاسِ﴾ Conjoined to الجنة. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis).

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾ The bāʾ is a preposition; mā is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿نَسِيتُمْ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from mā and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿لِقاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to يومكم. ﴿هذا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of يومكم. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿نَسِيناكُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَذُوقُوا﴾ An imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَذابَ الْخُلْدِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, annexed to الخلد; the clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf). ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ The restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿بِآياتِنَا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِذا﴾ A non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima). ﴿ذُكِّرُوا﴾ A passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿بِها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿خَرُّوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَسَبَّحُوا﴾ Conjoined to خروا. ﴿بِحَمْدِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and hum is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿تَتَجافى جُنُوبُهُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَنِ الْمَضاجِعِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿خَوْفاً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَطَمَعاً﴾ Conjoined to خوفا; the clause is a ḥāl as well. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause يدعون.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) and has no grammatical position. ﴿افْتَراهُ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ A particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُوَ الْحَقُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second ḥāl. ﴿ما أَتاهُمْ﴾ mā is negating, and a past verb and its mafʿūl. ﴿مِنْ﴾ A redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿نَذِيرٍ﴾ genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil of أتاهم; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of قوما. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its ism. ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of laʿalla, and the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ The Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the relative noun is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ Conjoined to السموات; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ Conjoined to السموات والأرض. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ An adverb of place. ﴿فِي سِتَّةِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿اسْتَوى﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. And ﴿ما﴾ is negating. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ khabar placed first. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ A redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿وَلِيٍّ﴾ A noun genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿شَفِيعٍ﴾ Conjoined to ولي. ﴿أَفَلا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ The hamza is a particle of interrogation and rebuke (tawbīkh), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿يُدَبِّرُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿يَعْرُجُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فِي يَوْمٍ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿كانَ مِقْدارُهُ﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿أَلْفَ﴾ Its khabar (predicate), annexed (muḍāf). ﴿سَنَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of يوم. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ألف. ﴿تَعُدُّونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ذلِكَ عالِمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾ Conjoined to الغيب. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ Two khabars as well.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾ The relative noun is a fourth khabar (predicate). ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to شيء. ﴿خَلَقَهُ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of شيء. ﴿وَبَدَأَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb conjoined to أحسن. ﴿خَلْقَ الْإِنْسانِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, annexed to الإنسان. ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿نَسْلَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ سُلالَةٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ ماءٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of سلالة. ﴿مَهِينٍ﴾ An adjective of ماء.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿سَوَّاهُ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿نَفَخَ﴾ Conjoined to سواه. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ رُوحِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well. ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ Conjoined to نفخ. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿السَّمْعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَبْصارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ﴾ Both conjoined to السمع. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿فَلا﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُخْفِيَ﴾ A passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ قُرَّةِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَعْيُنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿جَزاءً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جزاء. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كانوا.. is the ṣila of ما and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ The hamza is an interrogative particle, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and man is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose ism is latent (mustatir). ﴿مُؤْمِناً﴾ Its khabar (predicate); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿كَمَنْ﴾ The khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective past verb whose ism is latent. ﴿فاسِقاً﴾ Its khabar; the clause is the ṣila of من. ﴿لا يَسْتَوُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿أَمَّا﴾ A particle of condition and detailing (sharṭ wa-tafṣīl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ Conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿فَلَهُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa). ﴿لهم﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوى﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after, annexed to المأوى; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause أما الذين.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿نُزُلًا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نزلا. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا.., and the clause كانوا.. is the ṣila of ما and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَمَّا﴾ A particle of condition and detailing (sharṭ wa-tafṣīl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَسَقُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿فَمَأْواهُمُ﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa). ﴿مأواهم النَّارُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause أما الذين is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كُلَّما﴾ An adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَرادُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أرادوا. ﴿مِنْها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أُعِيدُوا﴾ A passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ Conjoined to أعيدوا. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قيل. ﴿ذُوقُوا﴾ An imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَذابَ النَّارِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, annexed to النار; the clause is the nāʾib fāʿil of قيل. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿بِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم.. is the ṣila of الذي and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ﴾ The wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the thing sworn by being omitted; the lām falls in the answer to the oath; and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَدْنى﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of العذاب. ﴿دُونَ الْعَذابِ﴾ An adverb of place annexed to العذاب. ﴿الْأَكْبَرِ﴾ An adjective of العذاب. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its ism. ﴿يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla, and the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿مَنْ أَظْلَمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم. ﴿ذُكِّرَ﴾ A passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿أَعْرَضَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿عَنْها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿مُنْتَقِمُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: the source gives no label for this word; it is the khabar of inna.] And the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ The wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the thing sworn by being omitted; the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسَى﴾ First mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَلا تَكُنْ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and its ism is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾ The khabar (predicate) of تكن; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ لِقائِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مرية. ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl. ﴿هُدىً﴾ Its second mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِبَنِي﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to هدى; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَئِمَّةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَهْدُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of أئمة. ﴿بِأَمْرِنا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ An adverb of time ("when", ḥīniyya). ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كانوا.. is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿هُوَ﴾ A pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿يَفْصِلُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ An adverb of place. ﴿يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾ An adverb of time annexed to القيامة. ﴿فِيما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يفصل. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause كانوا.. is the ṣila (relative clause) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:26-26.t:
﴿أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ﴾ The hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَمْ﴾ Declarative (khabariyya) [kam], in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أهلكنا placed first. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾
A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the fāʿil of يهد. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl as well. ﴿يَمْشُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فِي مَساكِنِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ A particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ Its khabar (predicate), placed first. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the ism of inna, placed after; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ The hamza is a particle of rebuking interrogation (istifhām tawbīkhī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and lā is negating. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ The hamza is a particle of rebuking interrogation (istifhām tawbīkhī), the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّا﴾ anna and its ism. ﴿نَسُوقُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna and what follows it is the mafʿūl of يروا. ﴿إِلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْجُرُزِ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of الأرض. ﴿فَنُخْرِجُ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿زَرْعاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَأْكُلُ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَنْعامُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَأَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾ Conjoined to أنعامهم; the clause is an adjective of زرعا. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ The hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُبْصِرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مَتى﴾ An interrogative noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿هذَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْفَتْحُ﴾ badal (substitute) for the demonstrative. ﴿إِنْ﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾ kāna, its ism and its khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ﴾ An adverb of time annexed to الفتح. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَنْفَعُ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿إِيمانُهُمْ﴾ The fāʿil of ينفع. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلا﴾ negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْظَرُونَ﴾ A passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. And the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فَأَعْرِضْ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَانْتَظِرْ﴾ Conjoined to اعرض. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُنْتَظِرُونَ﴾ inna, its ism and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl).

farraa:15-15.t: His saying: ﴿إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهَا خَرُّواْ سُجَّداً﴾: when the call to prayer was made, the hypocrites, if they were out of sight of the Muslims, would leave it; so Allah sent down: ﴿إنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهَا﴾ — when they are called to the prayer they come to it, and bow and prostrate without being arrogant.

farraa:16-16.t: His saying: ﴿تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ﴾: it is said that this is sleep before the ʿishāʾ (night prayer). They would not lay down their sides between maghrib and ʿishāʾ until they had prayed it. It is also said that throughout their whole night ﴿تَتَجَافَىٰ﴾ means: they are restless, ﴿عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ﴾: away from sleep during the night / 146 a [Translator's note: manuscript folio marker] — all of it, ﴿خَوْفاً وَطَمَعاً﴾ (in fear and hope).

farraa:17-17.t:
His saying: ﴿مَّآ أُخْفِيَ﴾: everyone gives the yāʾ a fatḥa, because it is a past verb, just as you say: أُهلِك الظالمون (the wrongdoers were destroyed).
Ḥamza read it (مَّآ أُخْفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ) with the yāʾ left quiescent [Translator's note: i.e. أُخْفِي, "I conceal"; the vowelling printed in the source quotation shows a fatḥa]. In the reading of ʿAbdullāh [ibn Masʿūd] it is (مَّآ نُخْفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ} ("what We conceal for them"), and this is a corroboration and support for Ḥamza. Both are correct. If you say ﴿أُخْفِيَ لَهُم﴾ and take (ما) in the sense of (أى) ("which?"), then (ما) is nominative as the deputy agent of a verb whose agent is not named. Whoever reads ﴿أُخْفِيَ لَهُم﴾ with the yāʾ quiescent and takes (ما) in the sense of (أىّ), it is accusative [as object] of ﴿أُخْفِى﴾ and ﴿نُخْفِى﴾. Whoever treats it as equivalent to "the thing" [i.e. as a relative noun, "that which"] makes (تَعْلَمُ) act upon it, so it is accusative in every one of the readings. It has also been read (قُرَّاتِ أعْيُن) (plural, "delights of the eyes"); this is reported from Abū Hurayra.

farraa:18-18.t: His saying: ﴿أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِناً كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقاً لاَّ يَسْتَوُونَ﴾: He did not say يستويان (the two are not equal, in the dual), because it is general; when two are not aimed at specifically [as particular individuals], they are treated like a plural. You say in ordinary speech: ما جعل الله المسلم كالكافر فلا تَسوِّيَنَّ بينهم (Allah has not made the Muslim like the unbeliever, so do not make them [plural] equal) — and بينهما (them two). Both are correct.

farraa:21-21.t: His saying: ﴿وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلأَدْنَىٰ﴾: Abū al-ʿAbbās narrated to us: Muḥammad narrated to us: al-Farrāʾ narrated to us, saying: Sharīk ibn ʿAbdullāh narrated to me from Manṣūr from Ibrāhīm or from Mujāhid — al-Farrāʾ was unsure — about His saying ﴿وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلأَدْنَىٰ﴾; he said: misfortunes that befall them in this world, short of Allah's punishment on the Day of Resurrection.

farraa:24-24.t: His saying: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُواْ﴾: the readers all have ﴿لَمَّا صَبَرُواْ﴾ with a doubled mīm and fatḥa on the lām. In the reading of ʿAbdullāh it is (بما صَبَروا) (because they were patient), and al-Kisāʾī and Ḥamza read it (لِما صَبَروا) on that basis. The position of (ما) is genitive (khafḍ) when the lām has a kasra. When the lām has a fatḥa and [the mīm] is doubled, it has no grammatical position; it is merely a particle.

farraa:26-26.t:
His saying: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا﴾: (كَمْ) is in the position of a nominative, through (يَهْدِ), as though you said: "Have the destroyed generations not guided them?" In the reading of ʿAbdullāh in Sūrat Ṭā Hā it is (أَوَلَمْ يَهد لهم مَنْ أهلكنا) ("Has it not guided them, those whom We destroyed?"). (كَم) may also be in the position of an accusative through أَهلكنا while carrying the meaning of a nominative; it is then like your saying: سواءُ عَلىّ أزيداً ضربت أم عمراً (it is the same to me whether you struck Zayd or ʿAmr), where you make (سواء) nominative by interpretation.
And you say: قد تبيّن لى أقام زيد أم عمرو (it has become clear to me whether Zayd or ʿAmr stood), so the clause is nominative in meaning, as if you had said: تبيَّن لى ذاك (that became clear to me).

farraa:27-27.t: His saying: ﴿إِلَى ٱلأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ﴾: al-juruz is land in which there is no vegetation. It is said of a she-camel إنها لجُرَاز when she eats everything, and of a person إنه لجَرُوز when he is a glutton, and a sword is جُرَاز when it leaves nothing without cutting it. One says أرض جُرُز and جُرْز, and أرْض جَرَز and جَرْزٌ — the latter of the Banū Tamīm; each of them, had it been read so, would have been good. It is like البُخُل، البُخْل، البَخَل and البَخْل (miserliness); and الرُغب، الرهب and الشغل each have four forms like that.

farraa:29-29.t: His saying: ﴿قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ﴾: meaning the conquest of Mecca. ﴿لاَ يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ إِيَمَانُهُمْ﴾: this was mentioned with regard to those of the Banū Kināna whom Khālid ibn al-Walīd killed on that day. They said: "We have become Muslims." Khālid said: "If you have become Muslims, lay down your weapons," and they did so; when they had laid them down, he slaughtered them heavily, because they had previously killed ʿAwf, the father of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf, and a grandfather of Khālid: al-Mughīra. If ﴿يوم الفتح﴾ were made nominative following the beginning of the speech — because in His saying ﴿مَتَى هذا الفتح﴾ (مَتى) is in the position of a nominative [Translator's note: the apodosis of this conditional is missing in the source; presumably "it would be correct"] — but the proper construction is for ﴿مَتَى﴾ to be in the position of an accusative, and that is more common.

farraa:7-7.t: His saying: ﴿ٱلَّذِيۤ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ﴾: he says: He made it good and rendered it beautiful. It is also read (أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُ); Abū Jaʿfar al-Madanī read it so, as though he said: He inspired His creation [with] everything they need. So "the creation" [Translator's note: in this reading] are in the accusative by the verb that falls on (كلّ), as though you said: He taught them everything and made them good [at it]. "Creation" may also be accusative as His saying ﴿أَمْراً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا﴾ is accusative, in many similar instances in the Quran — as though you said: everything, as a creation from Him and an initiation of favours.

farraa:10-10.t:
His saying: ﴿ضَلَلْنَا﴾ and ﴿ضَلِلْنا﴾ are two dialectal forms. It has been mentioned from al-Ḥasan and others that he read ﴿إذا صَلِلنا﴾, and it was even attributed to ʿAlī: ﴿صَلِلنا﴾ with ṣād. I do not know it, unless it is a dialect we have not heard. The Arabs only say: "ṣalla al-laḥmu, fa-huwa yaṣillu" (the meat went off), and "aṣalla yuṣillu", and "khamma yakhimmu" and "akhamma yukhimmu". Al-Farrāʾ said: had it been ṣalalnā with fatḥa on the lām, it would be correct, but I do not know it with kasra.
The meaning of ﴿إذا ضَلَلْنا فى الأرْضِ﴾: he says: when our flesh and bones have become dust like the earth. You say: "the water has become lost (ḍalla) in the milk", and "a thing has become lost in a thing" when it hides it and overwhelms it.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الم﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿تنزيل الكتاب لا ريب فيه من رب العالمين﴾: تنزيل: mubtadaʾ (subject); الكتاب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لا: the lā of generic negation; ريب: the noun of لا; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of لا; the clause ﴿لا ريب فيه﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الكتاب; من رب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; العالمين: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿أم يقولون افتراه﴾: أم is a disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction, so it means "rather" (بل) plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: "Rather, do they say he invented it?" (بل أيقولون افتراه), the hamza being for disapproving interrogation; or ﴿أم﴾ is connective (muttaṣila), in which case a clause must be supplied for the balance (taʿādul) to be sound, the implied form being: "Do they acknowledge it, or do they say: he invented it?" (أيقرون به أم يقولون: افتراه؟). The clause افتراه is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). يقولون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); افتراه: a past verb, the hāʾ being mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he".
﴿بل هو الحق من ربك﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); هو: mubtadaʾ (subject); الحق: khabar (predicate); ﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحق.
﴿لتنذر قوما ما أتاهم من نذير من قبلك﴾: the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); تنذر: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an optionally concealed أن after the causal lām; the concealed أن and the imperfect verb form an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the causal lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, i.e. "We sent it down so that you may warn" (أنزلناه لتنذر). The fāʿil of تنذر is latent, implied as "you"; قومًا: the first mafʿūl bihi, and the second object is omitted, the implied form being "so that you may warn a people of the punishment" (لتنذر قومًا العقاب); ما: negative; أتاهم: a past verb, the pronoun being mafʿūl bihi; مِن: a preposition that is ṣila (i.e. redundant); نذير: genitive in form, nominative in position as fāʿil; the clause ﴿ما أتاهم من نذير﴾ is an adjective of قومًا; من قبلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of نذير.
﴿لعلهم يهتدون﴾: لعل: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿يهتدون﴾ is the khabar of لعل; the clause of hoping is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of لتنذر, i.e. "that you may warn them, hoping for their guidance" (لتنذرهم راجيًا اهتداءهم).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض وما بينهما في ستة أيام﴾: the word of majesty (Allah) is mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿خلق...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. السماوات: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). الأرض: conjoined to السماوات, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿ما﴾: also conjoined to السماوات. بينهما: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. في ستة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلق; أيام: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ثم استوى على العرش﴾: ثم: a conjunction; استوى: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he", referring to Allah, glorified and exalted is He; على العرش: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استوى.
﴿ما لكم من دونه من ولي ولا شفيع﴾: ما: negative; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar; من دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial), the hāʾ being muḍāf ilayhi; من: a preposition that is ṣila (i.e. redundant); ولي: genitive in form, nominative in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ; the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is for emphasising the negation; شفيع: conjoined to ولي.
﴿أفلا تتذكرون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied that the context requires, i.e. "Do you not hear these admonitions and then not take heed of them?" (ألا تسمعون هذه المواعظ فلا تتذكرون بها) or "Do you hear these admonitions and then not take heed of them?" (أتسمعون هذه المواعظ فلا تتذكرون بها). لا: negative; تتذكرون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿يدبر الأمر من السماء إلى الأرض﴾: يدبر: a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); الأمر: the object of يدبر; من السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدبر﴾; إلى الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدبر﴾; the clause ﴿يدبر﴾ is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿الله﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ثم يعرج إليه في يوم كان مقداره ألف سنة مما تعدون﴾: ثم: a conjunction; يعرج: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعرج﴾; في يوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعرج﴾; كان: a defective, abrogating verb (kāna and its sisters); مقداره: the noun of كان, the hāʾ being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ألف: the khabar of كان; سنة: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿كان مقداره ألف سنة﴾ is an adjective of يوم; مما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of ﴿ألف﴾ or of ﴿سنة﴾; the clause ﴿تعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ذلك عالم الغيب والشهادة العزيز الرحيم﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); عالم: a first khabar (predicate); الغيب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is a conjunction; الشهادة: conjoined to الغيب; العزيز: a second khabar; الرحيم: a third khabar.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿الذي أحسن كل شيء خلقه﴾: الذي: a fourth khabar (predicate) or a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. كل: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); شيء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); خلقه: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿خلقه﴾ is an adjective of ﴿شيء﴾, in the position of genitive.
﴿وبدأ خلق الإنسان من طين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; بدأ: a past verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, implied as "he"; خلق: mafʿūl bihi; الإنسان: muḍāf ilayhi; من طين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلْق﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ثم جعل نسله من سلالة من ماء مهين﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; جعل: a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring to Allah the Exalted; نسله: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the hāʾ being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من سلالة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل or to a second object of جعل; من ماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of سلالة; مهين: an adjective of ماء.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ثم سواه ونفخ فيه من روحه وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence and delay; سواه: a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); نفخ: conjoined to سواه; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نفخ; من روحه: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to نفخ; the wāw is a conjunction; جعل: a verb and a latent fāʿil; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جعل or to a second object of جعل; السمع: mafʿūl bihi; الأبصار والأفئدة: both conjoined to السمع.
﴿قليلا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "you give little thanks" (تشكرون شكرا قليلا).
﴿ما﴾: ṣila (i.e. redundant), for emphasising the smallness.
﴿تشكرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿قليلا ما تشكرون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وقالوا أئذا ضللنا في الأرض أئنا لفي خلق جديد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the implied form being: "When we are lost in the earth, shall we be resurrected?" (أئذا ضللنا في الأرض نُبعَث). The clause ﴿ضللنا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضللنا. أئنا: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); في خلق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; جديد: an adjective of خلق; the clause ﴿وقالوا أئذا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿بل هم بلقاء ربهم كافرون﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); بلقاء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كافرون; ربهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; كافرون: the khabar of هم.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قل يتوفاكم ملك الموت الذي وكل بكم ثم إلى ربكم ترجعون﴾: قل: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; يتوفاكم: an imperfect verb, the kāf being a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ملك: fāʿil; الموت: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الذي: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ملك﴾; وُكِّل: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent, implied as "he"; بكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وُكِّل﴾; the clause ﴿وُكِّل بكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. ثم: a conjunction with delay; إلى ربكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ترجعون, the pronoun being muḍāf ilayhi; ترجعون: an imperfect verb, passive, and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ولو ترى إذ المجرمون ناكسو رءوسهم عند ربهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو: conditional; ترى: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; إذ: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾; المجرمون: mubtadaʾ (subject); ناكسو: khabar (predicate), and it is an active participle annexed to its object ﴿رءوسهم﴾; عند ربهم: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ربهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ترى﴾ here is complete (tāmma), taking no object, i.e. "if seeing were to occur on your part", or its object is omitted, the mubtadaʾ making its mention unnecessary, i.e. "and if you were to see the criminals" (ولو ترى المجرمين). The apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being: "you would have seen a dreadful matter" (لرأيت أمر فظيعا). [Translator's note: the source writes أمر; the accusative أمرًا is expected.]
﴿ربنا أبصرنا وسمعنا فارجعنا نعمل صالحا إنا موقنون﴾: ربنا: ﴿رب﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the vocative particle being omitted; أبصرنا: a verb and its fāʿil, the object omitted; the clause ﴿أبصرنا﴾ is the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position; سمعنا: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿سمعنا﴾ is conjoined to the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position. فارجعنا: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ارجعنا: a verb of supplication, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ارجعنا﴾ is conjoined to the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position; نعمل: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request; صالحا: mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نعمل﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "he did a righteous deed" (عمل عملًا صالحًا). [Translator's note: the source's paraphrase uses عمل; نعمل عملًا صالحًا would match the verse.] إنا موقنون: إنّ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ its noun, and موقنون its khabar.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ولو شئنا لآتينا كل نفس هداها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو: conditional; شئنا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); لآتينا: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; آتينا: a verb and its fāʿil; كل: the first object of آتينا; نفس: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); هداها: the second object of آتينا.
﴿ولكن حق القول مني لأملأن جهنم من الجنة والناس أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن: a particle of rectification (istidrāk); حق القول: a verb and its fāʿil; مني: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from القول. لأملأن: the lām is in the response to an implied oath; أملأن: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "I"; جهنم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من الجنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أملأن﴾; الناس: conjoined to الجنة; أجمعين: tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿فذوقوا بما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (faṣīḥa), conjoining to something implied, i.e. "it will be said to them: you abandoned faith, so taste!" (قيل لهم تركتم الإيمان فذوقوا). ذوقوا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); بما: the bāʾ is a preposition of causation, and ما is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar); نسيتم: a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿نسيتم﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذوقوا. The object of ﴿ذوقوا﴾ is omitted, implied as "the punishment" (العذاب); لقاء: the object of نسيتم; يومكم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); هذا: an adjective of يومكم.
﴿إنا نسيناكم﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; نسيناكم: a verb, its fāʿil and object; the clause ﴿نسيناكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
﴿وذوقوا عذاب الخلد بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ذوقوا: an imperative verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; عذاب: the object of ذوقوا; الخلد: muḍāf ilayhi; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذوقوا; كنتم: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ being its noun; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿إنما يؤمن بآياتنا الذين إذا ذكروا بها خروا سجدا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. إنما: the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; يؤمن: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); بآيتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمن﴾; الذين: fāʿil (agent); إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿ذكروا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it, and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); بها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذكروا; خروا: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿خروا﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb) of إذا; سجدا: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of خروا.
﴿وسبحوا بحمد ربهم وهم لا يستكبرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سبحوا: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿سبحوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿خروا﴾; بحمد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ﴿سبحوا﴾, i.e. "accompanied by His praise" (ملتبسين بحمده); ربهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لا يستكبرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿وهم لا يستكبرون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿تتجافى جنوبهم عن المضاجع﴾: تتجافى: an imperfect verb; جنوبهم: fāʿil (agent); عن المضاجع: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتجافى; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿يدعون ربهم خوفا وطمعا﴾: the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is either resumptive, with no grammatical position, or likewise circumstantial; يدعون ربهم: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿خوفا﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials), or else two maṣdars (verbal nouns) of an omitted verb, or else two mafʿūl li-ajlihi (objects of purpose); طمعا: conjoined to خوفا.
﴿ومما رزقناهم ينفقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينفقون; رزقناهم: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿رزقناهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. ينفقون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿فلا تعلم نفس ما أخفي لهم من قرة أعين جزاء بما كانوا يعملون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا: negative; تعلم نفس: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما: a relative noun, the object of تعلم; أخفي: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" [Translator's note: in the reading of Ḥafṣ, أُخْفِيَ is a passive past verb; the source calls it imperfect. Translated as written.]; من قرة أعين: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما; جزاء: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of requital", or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they are requited with a requital" (يجزون جزاء). بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جزاء﴾; كانوا: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural being its noun; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾: its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿أفمن كان مؤمنا كمن كان فاسقا﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the fāʾ is a conjunction; من: mubtadaʾ (subject); كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the noun of كان being latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; مؤمنا: the khabar (predicate) of كان; the clause ﴿كان مؤمنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. كمن: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿مَن﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); كان: a defective verb, its noun latent, implied as "he"; فاسقا: the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كان فاسقا﴾ is the ṣila of the second مَن, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا يستوون﴾: لا: negative; يستوون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿أما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فلهم جنات المأوى نزلا بما كانوا يعملون﴾: أما: a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject); آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. عملوا: a verb and its fāʿil; الصالحات: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause. فلهم: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لهم: a fronted khabar (predicate); جنات: a postponed mubtadaʾ; المأوى: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نزلا: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from جنات المأوى; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of ﴿نزلا﴾; ما: maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar) or relative; كانوا: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural being its noun; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وأما الذين فسقوا فمأواهم النار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أما: conditional, for detailing (tafṣīl); الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject); فسقوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿فسقوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); مأواهم: mubtadaʾ; النار: the khabar (predicate) of مأواهم; the clause ﴿مأواهم النار﴾ is the khabar of الذين.
﴿كلما أرادوا أن يخرجوا منها أعيدوا فيها﴾: ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعيدوا﴾, containing the sense of condition, and ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause ﴿أرادوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is an interpreted maṣdar, genitive by annexation, the implied form being "every wanting" (كلَّ إرادة), on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "every time of their wanting to come out" (كلَّ وقتِ إرادةٍ منهم للخروج). Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified by what follows, meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), with the referring pronoun omitted, the implied form being "every time in which they wanted to come out of it" (كلَّ وقتٍ أرادوا فيه أن يخرجوا منها), so the clause ﴿أرادوا﴾ is in the position of genitive as an adjective of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿أرادوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; أن: maṣdariyya; يخرجوا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنْ﴾ and what follows it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرادوا﴾, i.e. "whenever they wanted to come out of it" (كلما أرادوا الخروجَ منها). منها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يخرجوا; أعيدوا: a past verb, passive, and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعيدوا; the clause ﴿أعيدوا﴾ is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقيل لهم ذوقوا عذاب النار الذي كنتم به تكذبون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أعيدوا﴾; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قيل; ذوقوا: a verb and its fāʿil; عذاب: mafʿūl bihi; النار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿ذوقوا عذاب النار...﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); الذي: an adjective of عذاب; كنتم: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ being its noun; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تكذبون; the clause ﴿تكذبون﴾ is the khabar of كنتم. The clause ﴿كنتم به تكذبون﴾ is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ولنذيقنهم من العذاب الأدنى دون العذاب الأكبر لعلهم يرجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is in the response to an implied oath; نذيقنهم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "we"; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm the sign of the plural. من العذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نذيقنهم; الأدنى: an adjective of العذاب; دون: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿نذيق﴾; العذاب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الأكبر: an adjective; لعلهم: لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) expressing hope, and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿يرجعون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن ذكر بآيات ربه ثم أعرض عنها﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); أظلم: khabar (predicate); ممن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم; the clause ﴿ذُكِّر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, with no grammatical position. بآيات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذُكِّر; ربه: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ثم: a conjunction with delay; أعرض: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أعرض﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ذُكِّر﴾; عنها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعرض; the clause ﴿ومن أظلم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا من المجرمين منتقمون﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; من المجرمين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to منتقمون; منتقمون: the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فلا تكن في مرية من لقائه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the response to the omitted oath; قد: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); آتينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); موسى: the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of آتينا; الكتاب: the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (faṣīḥa); لا: prohibitive; تكن: a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the noun of تكن being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; في مرية: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna; من لقائه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of مرية.
﴿وجعلناه هدى لبني إسرائيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جعلناه: a verb, its fāʿil and the first mafʿūl bihi; هدى: the second mafʿūl bihi; لبني: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هدى﴾ or to an adjective of ﴿هدى﴾; إسرائيل: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وجعلنا منهم أئمة يهدون بأمرنا لما صبروا وكانوا بآياتنا يوقنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿جعلنا﴾; منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as the second object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; أئمة: the first object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; the clause ﴿يهدون﴾ is an adjective of أئمة; بأمرنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يهدون; لما: an adverb meaning "when" (حين), attached to جعلنا, and the apodosis of لما is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, the implied form being: "and when they were patient, We made from among them leaders" (ولما صبروا جعلنا منهم أئمة). كانوا: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural being its noun; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿صبروا﴾; بآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوقنون; يوقنون: the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿إن ربك هو يفصل بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ربك is its noun; هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and the clause يفصل: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; or ﴿هو﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause ﴿يفصل﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause ﴿هو يفصل﴾ the khabar of إنّ; بينهم: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) يفصل; يوم: an adverb attached to يفصل; القيامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); فيما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يفصل; كانوا: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural being its noun; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يختلفون; the clause ﴿يختلفون﴾ is the khabar of كان, and the clause ﴿كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿أولم يهد لهم كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مساكنهم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the wāw is a conjunction joining to something implied, the implied form being: "Have they been heedless, and has it not guided them?" (أغفلوا ولم يهد لهم), i.e. "has it not become clear (to them)?" (يتبيَّنْ). لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; يهد: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is omitted, indicated by the context, the implied form being: "Has it not guided them, how many generations We destroyed?" (أولم يهد لهم كثرة إهلاكنا القرون). كم: the predicative kam (khabariyya), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أهلكنا; من قبلهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from القرون; من القرون: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كم﴾; the clause ﴿يمشون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl from the pronoun in لهم; في مساكنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يمشون.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات﴾: إن: a particle of emphasis and accusative; في ذلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات: the postponed noun of إن.
﴿أفلا يسمعون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied that the context requires, i.e. "Have they gone deaf, so that they do not hear?" (أصموا فلا يسمعون). لا: negative; يسمعون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿أولم يروا أنا نسوق الماء إلى الأرض الجرز﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the wāw likewise is a conjunction joining to something implied; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; يروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); أنا: أنّ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿نسوق﴾ is its khabar (predicate); الماء: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿نسوق﴾; إلى الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نسوق﴾; الجرز: a naʿt (adjective) of الأرض; أنّ and what lies in its scope stand in place of the object of يروا.
﴿فنخرج به زرعا تأكل منه أنعامهم وأنفسهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; نخرج: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "we"; the clause ﴿نخرج﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿نسوق﴾; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نخرج; زرعا: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تأكل﴾ is an adjective of ﴿زرعا﴾; منه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تأكل; أنعامهم: the fāʿil of تأكل; أنفسهم: conjoined to أنعامهم.
﴿أفلا يبصرون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied that the context requires, i.e. "Have they gone blind, so that they do not see?" (أعموا فلا يبصرون). لا: negative; يبصرون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿ويقولون متى هذا الفتح إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يقولون: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); متى: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); هذا: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); الفتح: a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative; the clause ﴿ويقولون متى هذا الفتح﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن: conditional; كنتم: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ being its noun; صادقين: the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كنتم صادقين﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قل يوم الفتح لا ينفع الذين كفروا إيمانهم ولا هم ينظرون﴾: قل: an imperative verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); يوم: an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لا ينفع﴾; الفتح: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لا: negative; ينفع: an imperfect verb; الذين: the object of ينفع; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. إيمانهم: the postponed fāʿil of ﴿ينفع﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; لا: negative; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); ينظرون: an imperfect verb, passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿ينظرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فأعرض عنهم وانتظر إنهم منتظرون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (faṣīḥa); أعرض: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; عنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعرض; the wāw is a conjunction; انتظر: an imperative verb and a latent fāʿil, implied as "you", its object omitted. إنهم: إنّ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿منتظرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ [Translator's note: منتظرون is a single word (a noun), not a clause; translated as written]; منتظرون: an active participle, its object omitted.

zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat al-Sajda
Meccan,
except for three verses of it which are Medinan: ﴿أفَمَن كانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كانَ فاسِقًا﴾ [al-Sajda: 18], to the end of the three verses.
﷽
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿الم﴾ ﴿تَنْـزِيلُ الكِتابِ لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ﴾ [al-Sajda: 2] — Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal related, with a chain of transmission of his, «that the Prophet ﷺ used to recite every night Sūrat al-Sajda, "Alif Lām Mīm, Tanzīl," and Sūrat "Tabārak," al-Mulk». And Kaʿb al-Aḥbār related that he said: «"Whoever recites Sūrat al-Sajda, seventy good deeds are written for him, seventy evil deeds are removed from him, and he is raised seventy degrees."»
His saying: ﴿الم﴾ ﴿تَنْـزِيلُ الكِتابِ﴾ [al-Sajda: 2] — we have explained what has been said about ”الـم“. ”تَنْزِيلُ“ is nominative as the khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject), with the implied form "What we recite is the sending down of the Book." It may also be, in meaning, a khabar about ”الـم“, i.e. "Alif Lām Mīm is of the sending down of the Book." And it may be nominative as a mubtadaʾ, with the khabar of the mubtadaʾ being ”لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ“.

zajjaj:10-10.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَقالُوا أإذا ضَلَلْنا في الأرْضِ أإنّا لَفي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ﴾ — and it is read ”أنّا لَفي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ“, and it is read ”إنّا لَفي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ“. The position of ”إذا“ is accusative. Whoever reads ”أئِنّا“, it is in the sense of "Shall we be resurrected when we are lost in the earth?!", and ”إنّا لَفي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ“ indicates it. Whoever reads ”إنّا لَفي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ“, then ”إذا“ is accusative by ”ضَلَلْنا“, and it is in the sense of condition and recompense; and it does no harm that the fāʾ is not mentioned, because ”إذا“ has been followed by a past verb. It is not permissible for ”إذا“ to be made accusative by what comes after ”إنَّ“; there is no disagreement among the grammarians about that. The meaning of ”إذا ضَلَلْنا“ is: "when we have died and become dust and bones, and are lost in the earth, so that nothing of our form is discernible." And it is read ”صَلَلْنا“, with ṣād, and its meaning is of two kinds. One of them: "we have rotted and changed, and our forms have changed"; one says ”صَلَّ اللَّحْمُ“ and ”أصَلَّ“ when meat rots and changes. The second kind: ”صَلَلْنا“: we have become of the kind of al-ṣalla, which is dry earth.

zajjaj:11-11.t: His saying: ﴿قُلْ يَتَوَفّاكم مَلَكُ المَوْتِ﴾ — from paying a number in full; its interpretation is that he takes all your souls, so that not one of you is missing, as you say "I have received in full from so-and-so" and "I have received in full from so-and-so my property that was with him," whose interpretation is that nothing remains owed to me by him.

zajjaj:12-12.t:
His saying: ﴿وَلَوْ تَرى إذِ المُجْرِمُونَ ناكِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ — this has its apodosis (jawāb) left out. The address to the Prophet ﷺ is an address to creation; the proof of that is ﴿يا أيُّها النَّبِيُّ إذا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّساءَ﴾ [al-Ṭalāq: 1]. So it is equivalent to "if you (plural) were to see," and the apodosis is: "you would see that from which the utmost lesson is to be taken."
His saying: ﴿رَبَّنا أبْصَرْنا وسَمِعْنا﴾ — there is an implied "they say" in it: "they say: Our Lord, we have seen."

zajjaj:13-13.t:
His saying: ﴿وَلَوْ شِئْنا لآتَيْنا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُداها﴾ — its interpretation is like His saying: ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهم عَلى الهُدى﴾ [al-Anʿām: 35], and similar to it is: ﴿فَظَلَّتْ أعْناقُهم لَها خاضِعِينَ﴾ [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 4].
His saying: ﴿وَلَكِنْ حَقَّ القَوْلُ مِنِّي لأمْلأنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الجِنَّةِ والنّاسِ أجْمَعِينَ﴾ — Qatāda said: on account of their sins. And this is good, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, said: ﴿إنَّما تُجْزَوْنَ ما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ [al-Ṭūr: 16].

zajjaj:14-14.t: His saying: ﴿فَذُوقُوا بِما نَسِيتُمْ لِقاءَ يَوْمِكم هَذا إنّا نَسِيناكُمْ﴾ — the interpretation of forgetting here is abandoning. The meaning is: "So taste, because you abandoned working for the meeting of this Day of yours; so We have abandoned you [and kept you] from mercy."

zajjaj:16-16.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿تَتَجافى جُنُوبُهم عَنِ المَضاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهم خَوْفًا وطَمَعًا﴾ — the meaning of ”تَتَجافى“ is: they rise and leave their beds. The meaning of ”خَوْفًا وطَمَعًا“ is: in fear of Allah's punishment and in hope of Allah's mercy. ”خَوْفًا وطَمَعًا“ are accusative because they are mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose), as you say ”فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ حِذارَ الشَّرِّ“ (I did that in wariness of evil), i.e. for wariness of evil. Its reality is that it is in the position of a maṣdar (verbal noun), because "they call upon their Lord" in this place indicates that they fear His punishment and hope for His mercy; so it is in the interpretation of "they fear with fear and hope with hope."
His saying: ﴿وَمِمّا رَزَقْناهم يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ — i.e. they spend in obedience to Allah. There has been disagreement about its interpretation, and most of what has come in the tafsīr is that they used to pray at night at the time of the prescribed ʿatama (night) prayer, not sleeping through it. And it has been said: the voluntary prayer between the two prayers — the sunset prayer and the late-evening prayer.

zajjaj:17-17.t: His saying: ﴿فَلا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ ما أُخْفِيَ لَهم مِن قُرَّةِ أعْيُنٍ﴾ — is proof that it is the prayer in the depth of the night, because it is a deed which a person does in secret; so He made the wording of what it is rewarded with ”أُخْفِيَ“ (has been hidden). And it is read with the yāʾ vowelless, and the meaning is "what I hide for them" — a report from Allah [about Himself]. When it is read ”أُخْفِيَ لَهم مِن قُرَّةِ أعْيُنٍ“ — with fatḥa on the yāʾ — it is in the interpretation of the past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is what is in ”أُخْفِيَ“ referring to ”ما“. All the people read ”مِن قُرَّةِ أعْيُنٍ“ except Abū Hurayra, who read ”مِن قُرّاتِ أعْيُنٍ“ and related it from the Prophet ﷺ. ﴿جَزاءً بِما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ — ”جَزاءً“ is also accusative, a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose). And it has been read ”فَلا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ ما أخْفى لَهم“, i.e. "what Allah has hidden for them."

zajjaj:18-18.t: His saying: ﴿أفَمَن كانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كانَ فاسِقًا لا يَسْتَوُونَ﴾ — it has come in the tafsīr that it was revealed about ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, may Allah be pleased with him, and ʿUqba ibn Abī Muʿayṭ: the believer is ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, and the transgressor is ʿUqba ibn Abī Muʿayṭ. So Allah testified for ʿAlī to faith, and that he is in Paradise, by His saying: ﴿أمّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحاتِ فَلَهم جَنّاتُ المَأْوى﴾ [al-Sajda: 19]. He said ”لا يَسْتَوُونَ“ (they are not equal, plural); had He said ”لا يَسْتَوِيانِ“ (dual), it would have been permissible. But ”مَن“ has the wording of a singular while indicating both the singular and the plural; so ”لا يَسْتَوُونَ“ came in the sense of "the believers and the unbelievers are not equal." It is also possible that ”لا يَسْتَوُونَ“ is for the two, because the meaning of two is a plurality.

zajjaj:21-21.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهم مِنَ العَذابِ الأدْنى دُونَ العَذابِ الأكْبَرِ﴾ — ”اَلْأدْنى“ (the nearer) is what befalls them in this world. There has been disagreement about its interpretation. It has been said: what befalls them of drought and fear; and the proof of this view is His saying: ﴿وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكم بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الخَوْفِ والجُوعِ ونَقْصٍ مِنَ الأمْوالِ والأنْفُسِ والثَّمَراتِ﴾ [al-Baqara: 155]. And it has been said: ”اَلْعَذابُ الأدْنى“ here is captivity and killing. In sum, everything with which one is punished in this world is the nearer punishment, and the greater punishment is the punishment of the Hereafter.

zajjaj:23-23.t: His saying: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنا مُوسى الكِتابَ فَلا تَكُنْ في مِرْيَةٍ مِن لِقائِهِ﴾ — it has come in the tafsīr: "Do not be in doubt about meeting Mūsā, upon him be peace"; and the proof of this view in the tafsīr is His saying: ﴿واسْألْ مَن أرْسَلْنا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُسُلِنا﴾ [al-Zukhruf: 45]. So the meaning is: "Do not be, O Muḥammad, in doubt about meeting him." The address to the Prophet ﷺ is equivalent to an address to him and his community in this place, i.e. "so do not be in doubt about the Prophet's meeting, upon him be peace, with Mūsā." And it has been said: ”فَلا تَكُنْ في مِرْيَةٍ مِن لِقائِهِ“ means "of Mūsā's receiving the Book," so the hāʾ is for the Book, and in "his meeting" there is a reference to Mūsā. And it is possible that the hāʾ is for Mūsā and the Book is omitted, because the Book has been mentioned just as Mūsā has been mentioned; and this — and Allah knows best — is closer to the tafsīr.

zajjaj:24-24.t:
His saying: ﴿وَجَعَلْنا مِنهم أئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأمْرِنا﴾ — most of the Basrans do not permit ”أئِمَّةً“ with two hamzas; Ibn Abī Isḥāq alone permits the combination of two hamzas. Sībawayh, al-Khalīl and all the Basrans — except Ibn [Abī] Isḥāq — say ”أيِمَّةً“, with a hamza and a yāʾ; when the two hamzas are in one word they permit nothing but replacing the second, as in ”أيِمَّةً“ and ”آدَمَ“. Whoever reads ”أئِمَّةً“ is obliged to say for ”آدَمَ“ ”أأْدَمَ“, because it is [the pattern] ”أفْعَلُ“ from ”اَلْأُدْمَةُ“ (brownness), and ”أئِمَّةً“ is ”أفْعِلَةً“. It ought not to be read except as ”أيِمَّةً“, because whoever pronounces the hamza fully where lightening of the hamza is permissible [also] permits the lightening; so likewise he permits the lightening in ”أيِمَّةً“, and the reading ”أيِمَّةً“ thus becomes a matter of consensus.
His saying: ﴿لَمّا صَبَرُوا﴾, and ”لِما صَبَرُوا“ — the reading is with doubling and without doubling in ”لَمّا“. Without doubling, the meaning is: "We made them leaders because of their patience." Whoever reads ”لَمّا صَبَرُوا“, the meaning is that of recounting a recompense: "When they were patient, We made them leaders." The basis of the recompense in this is as though it had been said: "If you are patient, We will make you leaders; so when they were patient they were made leaders."

zajjaj:26-26.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿أوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهم كَمْ أهْلَكْنا﴾ — and it has been read with nūn: ”أوَلَمْ نَهْدِ لَهم“. One of the grammarians claimed that ”كَمْ“ is in the position of the nominative by ”يَهْدِ“, the meaning according to him being: "Have We not made clear to them the generations that We destroyed before them?!" This in our view — I mean in the view of the Basrans — is not permissible, because it makes what is before ”كَمْ“ govern ”كَمْ“. It is not permissible, in your saying ”كَمْ رَجُلٍ جاءَنِي“ (how many a man came to me!) when you are making a statement, to say ”جاءَنِي كَمْ رَجُلٍ“, because ”كَمْ“ is never moved from the initial position. For that reason it is permitted to separate it from what it governs when it is put in the accusative, in both the declarative and the interrogative [use]. You say in the declarative: ”كَمْ بِجُودٍ مُقْرِفًا نالَ الغِنى“ (how many a base-born man has attained riches through generosity!).
So you separated ”كَمْ“ from your saying ”مُقْرِفًا“ by your saying ”بِجُودٍ“; the separation in it between ”كَمْ“ and what it governs is a compensation for its [lack of] flexibility. Do you not see that ”عِشْرُونَ عِنْدِي دِرْهَمًا“ (twenty I have dirhams) is not permissible? Yet in the declarative ”كَمْ عِنْدِي دِرْهَمًا جَيِّدًا“ is permissible. The truth of this is that ”كَمْ“ is in the position of the accusative by ”أهْلَكْنا“, and the fāʿil (agent) of ”يَهْدِ“ is what the meaning indicates from the preceding speech; ”كَمْ“ is also an indication of the agent in ”يَهْدِي“. What indicates this is the reading of whoever read ”أوَلَمْ نَهْدِ“, with nūn, i.e. "Have We not made clear to them?!" It is also possible, with ”يَهْدِ“ with yāʾ, that the verb is Allah's, Mighty and Majestic is He; the reading of whoever read ”أوَلَمْ نَهْدِ“ indicates this.

zajjaj:27-27.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿أوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أنّا نَسُوقُ الماءَ إلى الأرْضِ الجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنهُ أنْعامُهم وأنْفُسُهُمْ﴾ — it is read ”اَلْجُرُزِ“, and ”اَلْجَرَزِ“, ”اَلْجُرْزِ“ and ”اَلْجَرْزِ“ are permissible; all of that has been reported for ”اَلْجُرُزِ“. It has come in the tafsīr that it is the land of Yemen. ”اَلْجُرُزُ“ according to the people of the language is land that does not put forth vegetation; its origin was that it eats up its vegetation. One says ”اِمْرَأةٌ جَرُوزٌ“ when a woman is a big eater, and one says ”سَيْفٌ جُرازٌ“ when a sword cuts off at the root. Whoever says ”جُرْزٌ“, it is a lightening of ”جُرُزٌ“; and whoever says ”جَرَزٌ“ and ”جَرْزٌ“, they are two dialect forms. It is also possible that ”جَرْزٌ“ is a maṣdar (verbal noun) used as a description, as though it is land possessed of jarz — I mean with sukūn on the rāʾ — i.e. possessed of the eating up of vegetation.
His saying: ﴿يَمْشُونَ في مَساكِنِهِمْ﴾ [al-Sajda: 26] — in ”يَمْشُونَ في مَساكِنِهِمْ“, ”تَمْشُونَ“ (you walk) is permissible.

zajjaj:28-28.t: His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ مَتى هَذا الفَتْحُ إنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾ — it has come in the tafsīr that the Companions of the Prophet, upon him be peace, said: "Soon there will be for us a day on which we have rest." So the idolaters said: "When is this victory (fatḥ), if you are truthful?!" Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, made known that rest is in Paradise, in the Hereafter. It has also come concerning al-fatḥ: "When is this judgement, if you are truthful?!" and "When is this decision?!" So Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, made known that on the Day of Decision (fatḥ) the faith of those who disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be granted respite; i.e. as long as they are in this world, repentance is offered to them, but there is no repentance in the Hereafter.

zajjaj:3-3.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿أمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَراهُ﴾ — its meaning is: "Rather, do they say: he invented it?"
His saying: ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا ما أتاهم مِن نَذِيرٍ مِن قَبْلِكَ﴾ — and similar to it is ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا ما أُنْذِرَ آباؤُهُمْ﴾ [Yā Sīn: 6]. ”ما“ in both places is negation, i.e. neither they nor their fathers witnessed a prophet. As for the warning by the earlier messengers of Allah, Allah's blessings be upon them, the proof is established against their fathers through it, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, punishes only whoever disbelieves in the messengers; the proof of that is His saying: ﴿وَما كُنّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتّى نَبْعَثَ رَسُولا﴾ [al-Isrāʾ: 15].

zajjaj:30-30.t: ﴿فَأعْرِضْ عَنْهم وانْتَظِرْ إنَّهم مُنْتَظِرُونَ﴾ — and it has been read ”فانْتَظِرْ إنَّهم مُنْتَظِرُونَ“, and ”مُنْتَظَرُونَ“ (they are awaited).

zajjaj:5-5.t: His saying: ﴿ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إلَيْهِ في يَوْمٍ كانَ مِقْدارُهُ ألْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمّا تَعُدُّونَ﴾ — Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, made known that He directs the affair from the heaven to the earth, then the affair ascends to Him in a day, and that day's measure is a thousand years of what you count. The meaning of ”يَعْرُجُ“ is: descends and ascends [Translator's note: so in the source, «يَنْزِلُ، ويَصْعَدُ»]. One says ”عَرَجْتُ في السُّلَّمِ، أعْرُجُ“ (I climbed the ladder), and one says ”عَرِجَ، يَعْرُجُ“ when one becomes lame.

zajjaj:7-7.t:
His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿الَّذِي أحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ﴾ — it has been read ”خَلَقَهُ“ both with a vowel on the lām and with sukūn on it; and ”خَلْقُهُ“, in the nominative, is permissible, but I do not know of anyone who read it. As for ”خَلَقَهُ“, it is as the past verb; and the interpretation of "making good" in this is that He created it according to His will: He created the human being in the finest stature, and He created the ape as He, Mighty and Majestic is He, wished, and His creating it thus is of the most consummate wisdom. Whoever reads ”خَلْقَهُ“, with sukūn on the lām, it is in two ways: one of them is as the maṣdar (verbal noun) indicated by ”أحْسَنَ“, the meaning being "He who created everything, a creating of it"; and it may be as a badal (substitute), so the meaning would be "He who made good the creation of everything, its creation." The nominative is with the implied form "that is His creation."
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَبَدَأ خَلْقَ الإنْسانِ مِن طِينٍ﴾ — He means Adam and his offspring; for Adam was created from clay.

zajjaj:8-8.t: ﴿ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِن سُلالَةٍ مِن ماءٍ مَهِينٍ﴾ — the meaning of ”مَهِينٍ“ is: weak. The meaning of ”اَلسُّلالَةُ“ in the language is the small amount that slips out of a thing; and likewise [the pattern] ”اَلْفُعالَةُ“, such as ”اَلْفُضالَةُ“ (leftover), ”اَلنُّخامَةُ“ (phlegm) and ”اَلْقُوارَةُ“ (cut-off piece).
